_why: Operator question 2026-10-09: keep backup and recovery in sync with what each change adds. scripts/check_backup_coverage.py --fail-on-new fails when a repo-declared asset has no asset class here, or when an asset falls into a NONE/PARTIAL class and is not in config/backup_coverage_baseline.json. The gate never edits a recovery script.
_how_to_add: New store/unit/secret/persistent tree: add its exact id to the covers list of the class whose mechanism backs it up. If nothing does, add it to a NONE class (or create one with mechanism NONE and a gap note) and add the id to the baseline with a reason. Tables are matched by schema pattern; a new schema needs a pattern. Never claim a mechanism that does not copy the asset.
